description: Cloudflare WAF and Firewall Rules for Jainune API

rules.description: Block automated scraping tools, headless browsers, and vulnerability scanners
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap" or http.user_agent contains "nikto" or http.user_agent contains "python-requests" or http.user_agent contains "Go-http-client" or http.user_agent contains "curl") and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/v1/health")

rules.description: Managed challenge on low-score automated clients hitting authentication
rules.expression: cf.bot_management.score lt 30 and (http.request.uri.path contains "/v1/auth/otp/request" or http.request.uri.path contains "/v1/auth/email/otp/request" or http.request.uri.path contains "/v1/auth/google" or http.request.uri.path contains "/v1/auth/apple")

rules.description: Rate limit OTP requests per IP to prevent SMS fatigue and cost exhaustion
Flag anomalous international traffic on local currency payment routes
